checks.requirement: **Low-friction onboarding.** A new candidate reaches a reviewed master record and a first prepared packet by conversation and import, with few interventions
checks.evidence_required: Fresh install on a clean machine, fictional persona, run end to end. Counts of user turns, repeated questions, manual edits and rescues. Time and calls. Variance across repeats
checks.falsifier: A required step needs a hand-edited file. The same settled fact is unnecessarily requested again; an explicit candidate-only confirmation is not a redundant factual question. Onboarding assumes a field, degree or career stage. Interventions are not measured
checks.review_note: Baseline finding: live profile assistant moves to summarizing after 2-4 stories (all 11 transcripts; ending joint with the scripted candidate) (coverage of all facts 0.33-0.6); conversation-built runs pass 2/9 vs seeded 9/9. | 2026-11-16 root review. Local evidence present: fresh-clone install, then npm ci, setup and start (U12), plus a controlled onboarding proof x3 (scripts/onboarding-proof.mjs): 21 interventions per run, 0 repeated questions, 0 rescues, first reviewed master at 10 calls and first packet at 14. Live onboarding report over 74 runs (scripts/onboarding-report.mjs): conversation-built 5.6±1.0 turns, 0.4±0.6 repeated questions, 11.5±1.6 calls, 9/18 pass. The interview fixes raised paired conversation-built runs from 2/9 to 7/9. Open: fresh LIVE onboarding on a clean machine. blocked: provider-quota (Codex limit reached 2026-11-16).

checks.requirement: **Durable candidate memory.** Facts with provenance, contradictions and unknowns, preferences, voice and taste, several writing samples, strengths and constraints. Editable and deletable. Survives restart and a provider switch. Sharing controls. Approved corrections reused later. No invented identity
checks.evidence_required: Restart and provider-switch test on memory contents. Edit and delete tests with downstream effect. A planted contradiction is surfaced, not silently resolved. An approved correction changes a later packet. An excluded source leaves provider context and clears approvals
checks.falsifier: Memory differs after restart or provider switch. A deleted fact still appears in a packet. A contradiction is resolved without the candidate. A fact has no source. Identity detail appears that no source holds
checks.review_note: M2 (factual-source gate) and M1 (lossless export/import with approval reset, autonomy off, held unverifiable answers, atomic recovery) integrated; root probes confirm restart/provider-switch persistence and the five-key import loss closed. Open: M3 story edit/delete, M4 approved-correction reuse in drafting, M5 contradictions, real-model contribution. | 2026-11-16 accepted by root (author OMP DeepSeek lanes M1-M6; root is a different family). Evidence: restart and provider-switch probes; story edit/delete with downstream invalidation (M3, mutation-checked); planted contradiction surfaced with both quotes and never silently resolved (M5); approved correction changes a later packet (M4 two-job test); excluded source leaves provider context and clears approvals (U11, M6). Probe scripts/memory-probe.mjs: 47 checks, 0 failures. Root-authored fixes were independently reviewed (root-fixes-review). Residual: no semantic contradiction detection, by design; the real-model memory contribution is not measured separately.

checks.requirement: **Master completeness.** The master record is complete and canonical. The master resume is derived from it, inspectable, with no length limit, and lists what it missed
checks.evidence_required: Multi-role, multi-stage fictional personas with older roles, certifications and a career gap. Check each source role, result and credential appears in the master or is listed as missing. Tailoring leaves the master byte-identical
checks.falsifier: A source role, result or credential is silently absent. The master adds an unsupported line. Tailoring changes the master. The old standard resume is treated as current without a flag
checks.review_note: Continuation integrated: master resume replaces standard; heading now part of approval identity and visible. Lexical masterCoverage and 150-entry cap remain measured gaps; no multi-role persona run. | 2026-11-16 accepted by root (author OMP DeepSeek). plainhand/master-completeness.mjs lists every source role, credential, degree and number-bearing result as present (with its entry index) or missing. Held-out multi-role personas with older roles, certs and a gap: a scripted drop of one old role and one cert lists exactly those two; a full master scores 8/8. Two tailored packets leave the stored master byte-identical (digest). Entry cap removed (200 accepted). Profile card shows what was missed. Residual: detection is lexical and deterministic.

checks.requirement: **Per-job relevance and order.** Each tailored resume selects and orders for the job and keeps older relevant roles
checks.evidence_required: Paired jobs with the same persona where the right selection differs. Held-out cases. Scored selection and order, plus an old-but-relevant role planted. Judge on relevance with quote validation
checks.falsifier: An older role that matches the job is dropped. An irrelevant role leads. A pre-specified pair requiring different evidence produces the same selection despite the documented relevance difference. Selection is correct only because the job vocabulary was copied
checks.review_note: Per-job selection/order mechanism merged with continuation (f366946); no root-run paired or held-out evidence yet, so the row stays not_run. Baseline finding: tailoring keeps reverse-chronological order; old relevant role does not lead (2 of 6 held-out); judge structure ~3.4/5. Owner decision 2026-11-15 (how tailoring should work): from the master record, keep only the experience relevant to the job and drop the rest; curate each kept role's lines to the role; order the kept roles newest first by default, or with the strongest match on top when the candidate chooses that (a per-candidate setting). Cover letter: a concise restatement of the strongest matches in the resume (owner to double-check this convention). Note: the frozen leadShare check encodes 'old relevant role leads'; under this decision it holds only when the newer roles are irrelevant and dropped, so scorer v2 must check order against the candidate's chosen setting. | 2026-11-16. The owner's ordering decision is implemented (settings.roleOrder recent|match; irrelevant roles dropped; a role holding a required fact is never dropped). Scorer v3 gates order against roleOrder. Live paired run 0f5cfe8: role order correct 19/19, 0 required roles dropped. Judge relevance 4.23 (uncalibrated). Held-out set 2 (recent and match rows, newer-unrelated row) has not run live. blocked: provider-quota.

checks.requirement: **Grounded reusable answers with uncertainty.** Answers cite sources, flag what is unsettled, and are reused. No repeated question when sources settle it
checks.evidence_required: Repeat-question counter over a multi-application run. Planted settled and unsettled facts. Answers given to flagged fields offered to the answer bank
checks.falsifier: A settled non-sensitive fact is unnecessarily asked again. An unsettled fact is answered without a flag. An answer cannot be traced to a source. A sensitive answer is reused without the candidate
checks.review_note: 2026-11-16 accepted by root. Answers cite sources with provenance (sourceKind; assertions never ground packets). Unsettled facts are flagged: conflicts block only citing packets, and fit doubts go to suggestions, not blocking questions. Reuse: approved factual answers are reused with their bank quote, and review re-runs. Repeat-question counter: M5 ledger plus settled-fact lookup (profile, bank, packet) before asking; live onboarding report 0.4±0.6 repeats per conversation; the same-turn answer fix closes an area at once. Typed answers to form fields are offered to the bank job-scoped. Mutation checks on reuse, edit, expiry, scope, sensitivity and sourceKind.

checks.requirement: **Quality-preserving queues and autonomy.** Batches and queues, resume, retry, cancel, opt-in autonomy within limits
checks.evidence_required: Interrupt-and-resume, per-item retry and cancel tests. Daily limit honored. Packet quality in a queued run compared with a single run on the same inputs
checks.falsifier: Repeated paired runs exceed the frozen quality-regression bound; a single stochastic difference is not sufficient evidence. A limit is exceeded. Autonomy is on by default. Cancel leaves a confirmable action. A restart loses queue state
checks.review_note: 2026-11-16 accepted by root. Batch order, process-stop recovery (interrupted, retryable, no duplicates, no approvable half-packet), per-item retry and cancel (cancel-before-commit fix), autonomy off by default, minScore and approved master, perDay limit with recorded refusal and next-day reset (injectable clock), never submits. Queued and single runs give byte-identical packets on the deterministic agent. Live queued-vs-single repeat comparison (scripts/queue-vs-single.mjs --provider) not run: provider-quota. Residuals: queued work is marked interrupted rather than auto-resumed; turning autonomy off does not cancel an already-queued auto-prepare.

checks.requirement: **Quota efficiency at volume.** A candidate on an ordinary subscription can prepare many applications per quota window, not one or two. Model calls, tokens and wall time per application are measured per provider and reduced without losing quality
checks.evidence_required: Per-application calls, input/output/reasoning tokens and wall time recorded for every live run (baseline first). Quota consumed per application, given as a share of the provider's subscription window where it can be measured. A leaner pipeline compared with the frozen baseline on the same scenarios: equal or better quality scores, fewer calls or tokens
checks.falsifier: Cost per application is not measured, or is estimated without run data. A cost cut lowers a quality or grounding score. A typical subscription window covers only one or two applications and no reduction is planned
checks.review_note: Added 2026-11-15 at owner request. Owner chose Codex for the live baseline; the baseline must record usage so this row has a starting figure. Starting figure (baseline 00ce1bf): seeded application 5 calls/121k input tokens; conversation-built 11 calls/280k; journey 15 calls/374k. Codex-reported input ~25k tokens per call (includes CLI overhead; Plainhand share unmeasured). Cached/reasoning tokens dropped by the runner, not measured; model unrecorded. | 2026-11-16. Measured: about 225 codex exec calls per reset window; 75-80% of each call's input was CLI overhead. Implemented: Codex overhead cut (mock-measured request 61,035 B to 18,190 B; non-prompt overhead -95%); Claude --system-prompt (-23%); evaluate content-hash cache; opt-in humanizer fold (default off, to keep CLAUDE.md's separate humanizer pass); usage records cached/reasoning tokens and promptChars. Projection: seeded 45 to 56 applications per window from calls alone, more from tokens. Open: confirm billed tokens and quality parity on a live paired run. blocked: provider-quota.
